svg.title: Narrowing the candidate models for a TaskFlow feature
svg.desc: A funnel of five stages with example counts. Stage one: every model you could call, the current models across the providers you have contracts with, about 15 in this example. Stage two: hard constraints that cannot be traded, such as data terms, region, a BAA, modalities, context window, tools and structured output; 8 candidates remain. Stage three: task evaluation on TaskFlow's own cases, measuring the pass rate on about 200 cases per feature; 4 remain. Stage four: latency and cost, checking p95 latency against the feature's budget and the cost per passing case; 2 remain. Stage five: pick per feature, a primary tier plus one evaluated fallback.

g.text: current models across the providers you have contracts with
data terms, region, BAA, modalities, context window, tools, structured output
pass rate on TaskFlow's own cases, per feature
p95 within budget; cost per passing case
Filter on what cannot be traded first; compare quality only among models you are allowed to use.
